# The Study Hub

> A high school student club in Orange County, California. Bilingual high school volunteers give free online homework help to elementary students (TK–5th grade) who are learning English. Sessions are 30 minutes or less on Google Meet; tutors help with the hard part of the homework, not the whole assignment, on weekday afternoons.

- Cost: free. No payment information is ever collected.
- Languages: Spanish, Mandarin, Korean, Vietnamese, Arabic, Tagalog and more, depending on volunteers.
- How to book: a parent or guardian picks a tutor and time at https://thestudyhub.us/, uploads photos of the homework, and receives the Google Meet link by email once the tutor approves.
- Safety: tutors are approved by club officers and follow a code of conduct; a parent stays nearby during every session; homework photos are deleted 30 days after the session.
- Contact: help@thestudyhub.us · Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/the_studyhub1/

- [About](https://thestudyhub.us/about.html): founded by Liz Flores, a junior at Cerritos High School
- [Help](https://thestudyhub.us/help.html): step-by-step guides for parents, tutors and club officers
- [Rules, terms and privacy](https://thestudyhub.us/rules.html): terms of use, privacy policy, parent consent, tutor code of conduct
